scope: Untimed observer admission. These attempts are not warmups or paired measurements.

initial_attempt.reason: An immediate post-Popen /proc/PID/environ read did not return the requested research mode.

diagnosis.error_interpretation: An empty initial read cannot prove that a mode is absent.

amendment.identity_check: Keep the executable inode check at launch. Verify the one requested environment key against a nonempty live procfs read after the X11 observations, plus each of the two application's actual mode records.
amendment.initial_stock_evidence: stock-initial-setup.json retains the initial observer output. Its environment-verification flag is not accepted as proof of absence because its immediate read could have been empty.
